title: Christopher Tin - Baba Yetu (Official Video) feat. Soweto Gospel Choir
summary: The official video for Baba Yetu, Christopher Tin's Swahili-language choral piece written as the theme to Civilization IV. It was the first video game music to win a Grammy.
why: HN commenters hold it up as the greatest video game song, evoking wonder and pride in humanity.

quote.text: What about the greatest video game song ever produced (Baba Yetu)
